lessons.title: What is a Database?

bulletPoints: Core concept: What is a Database?

lessons.title: Wildcards

lessons.title: Union

lessons.title: Joins

lessons.title: Nested Queries

lessons.title: On Delete

lessons.title: Triggers

physics-mechanics-fundamentals.title: Physics: Mechanics & Energy
physics-mechanics-fundamentals.tagline: Master classical mechanics, 1D motion, Newton's laws, energy conservation, and universal gravitation.

lessons.title: Introduction to Kinematics & 1D Motion
lessons.overview: Explore position, velocity, and acceleration. Understand how objects move in one dimension through vectors and kinematic equations.

lessons.title: Newton's Laws of Motion & Forces
lessons.overview: Discover the three fundamental laws formulated by Sir Isaac Newton: inertia, F = ma, and action-reaction pairs.
pts: Inertia and balanced vs unbalanced forces
Calculating net force with F = ma

lessons.title: Work, Energy & Power
lessons.overview: Learn how mechanical work transfers energy. Master the Work-Energy Theorem and the conservation of kinetic and potential energy.
pts: Kinetic energy (1/2 mv²) vs potential energy (mgh)
Law of conservation of mechanical energy
Power as the rate of energy transfer

lessons.title: Universal Gravitation & Orbital Motion
lessons.overview: Examine Newton's universal law of gravitation and how gravitational forces keep planets and satellites in elliptical orbits.

calculus-advanced-mathematics.title: Mathematics: Calculus & Analysis
calculus-advanced-mathematics.tagline: Comprehensive journey through differential and integral calculus, limits, continuity, rate of change, and geometric area integrals.

lessons.title: Limits & Continuity Fundamentals
lessons.overview: Understand what happens as input values approach a point. Master epsilon-delta definitions, one-sided limits, and continuity.
pts: Intuitive and formal concept of limits
Definition of continuity at a point

lessons.title: The Derivative & Rates of Change
lessons.overview: Explore instantaneous rate of change and the geometric slope of tangent lines. Learn power, product, quotient, and chain rules.
pts: Difference quotient and limit definition of derivative
Power rule, product rule, and quotient rule

lessons.title: Antiderivatives & Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
lessons.overview: Connect derivatives and integrals through the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus. Practice definite and indefinite integrals.
pts: Riemann sums and area under curves

lessons.title: Applications of Integration: Area & Volume
lessons.overview: Calculate area between intersecting curves and volumes of solids of revolution using disk and washer methods.
pts: Disk and washer method for rotational solids

general-physical-chemistry.title: Chemistry: Atoms, Bonds & Reactions
general-physical-chemistry.tagline: Investigate quantum electron orbitals, ionic and covalent bonding, stoichiometric reaction yields, and acid-base titration equilibria.

lessons.title: Electronic Structure & Atomic Orbitals
lessons.overview: Learn how quantum numbers, electron configurations, and s, p, d, f orbitals shape the periodic table and elemental reactivity.
pts: Bohr model vs Quantum mechanical orbital model
Principal, angular, and magnetic quantum numbers
Periodic trends in electronegativity and radius

lessons.title: Ionic & Covalent Chemical Bonds
lessons.overview: Investigate how atoms share and transfer valence electrons to achieve noble gas configurations. Explore Lewis structures and polarity.

lessons.title: Balancing Reactions & Stoichiometry
lessons.overview: Balance chemical equations and use mole ratios to predict product yields, determine limiting reactants, and calculate percent yield.
pts: Conservation of mass in chemical reactions

lessons.title: Acids, Bases & Titration Equilibrium
lessons.overview: Examine Arrhenius and Bronsted-Lowry definitions of acids and bases, pH scale logarithms, and volumetric titration curves.
pts: Calculating pH from hydronium ion concentration
Neutralization reactions and titration equivalence points

cellular-biology-genetics.title: Biology: Cells & Molecular Genetics
cellular-biology-genetics.tagline: Explore living systems from cellular organelles and ATP cellular respiration to DNA replication, central dogma, and Mendelian inheritance.

lessons.title: Cell Organelles & Membrane Transport
lessons.overview: Tour prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, organelles (nucleus, mitochondria, ribosomes, ER), and phospholipid bilayer transport mechanisms.
pts: Passive diffusion and osmosis vs active transport

lessons.title: Cellular Respiration & ATP Synthesis
lessons.overview: Learn how cells convert glucose into cellular energy (ATP) through glycolysis, the Krebs citric acid cycle, and oxidative phosphorylation.
pts: Krebs cycle in the mitochondrial matrix
Electron transport chain and proton gradients
ATP synthase and aerobic vs anaerobic yield

lessons.title: DNA Structure, Replication & Protein Synthesis
lessons.overview: Understand the double helix architecture discovered by Watson, Crick, and Franklin, semiconservative replication, and central dogma.
pts: Helicase, DNA polymerase, and replication forks
Transcription of mRNA in the nucleus
Translation at ribosomes via tRNA codons

lessons.title: Mendelian Genetics & Heredity
lessons.overview: Explore Gregor Mendel's laws of segregation and independent assortment, Punnett squares, dominant and recessive alleles, and pedigrees.
pts: Monohybrid and dihybrid Punnett square predictions
Sex-linked traits and human genetic conditions

python-programming-essentials.title: Python Programming Essentials
python-programming-essentials.tagline: From beginner syntax to structured programming: master dynamic typing, collections, conditionals, iteration, and reusable modular functions.

lessons.title: Python Syntax, Variables & Types
lessons.overview: Introduction to Python environment, dynamic typing, numbers, strings, and standard input/output with clean syntax.
pts: Interpreted nature and Python execution model
Variables, type casting, and string formatting
Writing your first interactive Python script

lessons.title: Lists, Dictionaries & Sets
lessons.overview: Master Python's built-in data collections: ordered lists, key-value hash dictionaries, immutable tuples, and unique sets.
pts: List indexing, slicing, and mutation methods

lessons.title: Conditional Statements & Loops
lessons.overview: Direct execution flow with if, elif, and else conditionals. Iterate efficiently over ranges and collections with for and while loops.
pts: Boolean logic: and, or, not expressions
For loop iteration over sequences and ranges
While loops with break and continue statements

lessons.title: Defining Functions & Scope
lessons.overview: Write reusable, testable code blocks with def statements, positional and keyword arguments, default parameters, and docstrings.
pts: Function definition, return values, and None

modern-web-development-html-css.title: Web Development: HTML & CSS
modern-web-development-html-css.tagline: Learn fundamental front-end web engineering with semantic HTML5 elements, accessible forms, modern CSS box models, and responsive Flexbox.

lessons.title: HTML Document Anatomy & Semantic Tags
lessons.overview: Understand the DOM tree, doctype, head metadata, and modern semantic tags (<header>, <nav>, <main>, <section>, <article>, <footer>).
pts: Anatomy of an HTML document and DOM hierarchy
Semantic tags for SEO and accessibility
Text elements: headings, paragraphs, and emphasis

lessons.title: HTML Forms, Inputs & Media
lessons.overview: Create user input forms with validation, labels, text fields, radio buttons, checkboxes, dropdowns, and embedded media elements.
pts: Form element: action and method attributes
Input types: text, email, password, number

lessons.title: CSS Selectors & The Box Model
lessons.overview: Style web pages using CSS selectors, cascade specificity, typography, colors, and the core Box Model (content, padding, border, margin).
pts: The Box Model: content, padding, border, margin

lessons.title: CSS Flexbox & Responsive Design
lessons.overview: Master 1D responsive layouts with CSS Flexbox: main axis, cross axis, justify-content, align-items, flex-wrap, and media queries.
